texts.preamble: State Of Gujarat vs Gulam Mohmmed Tarmohmmed ... on 22 July, 2015 Author: S.G.Shah Bench: S.G.Shah R/Cr.A/1336/2012 Judgment In The High Court Of Gujarat At Ahmedabad Criminal Appeal No. 1336 of 2012 For Approval And Signature: Honourable Mr.Justice S.G.Shah ========================================================== 1 Whether Reporters of Local Papers may be allowed to see the judgment ? 2 To be referred to the Reporter or not ? 3 Whether their Lordships wish to see the fair copy of the judgment ? 4 Whether this case involves a substantial question of law as to the interpretation of the Constitution of India or any order made thereunder ? = = == ===================================================== = State Of GUJARAT....Appellant(s) Versus Gulam Mohmmed Tarmohmmed MEMAN....Opponent(s)/Respondent(s) ========================================================= = Appearance: Mr Kl Pandya, Addl. Public Prosecutor for the Appellant(s) No. 1 Mr Kartik I Soni, Advocate for the Opponent(s)/Respondent(s) No. 1 ========================================================== Coram: Honourable Mr.Justice S.G.Shah State Of Gujarat vs Gulam Mohmmed Tarmohmmed ... on 22 July, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29494383/ 1 Date : 22/07/2015 Oral Judgment 1.
texts.arguments: 3. The case of the complainant, being Senior Food Inspector before the trial Court was to the effect that respondent herein is running a shop in the name and style of Saurashtra Cold-drinks and dealing with cold beverages like lemon, orange, rimzim, masal soda, kalakhatta, mango etc. and on the date of raid i.e. on 04.03.2004 the complainant has purchased 6 bottles of orange sweetened carbonated water after making payment and taken specimen from such bottles and on analysis, it was found that it was mis-branded and thereby complaint was lodged against respondent and after trial, he was convicted as aforesaid. It is material to note that even while collecting the samples, complainant has to disclose that he has purchased the material of Rimzim brand and, therefore, it becomes clear that respondent has not manufactured all such product, which is sold in a packed bottle and ready to serve. It is also clear that even public analyst has after examination, simply reported that it is mis - branded but there is no result or report regarding any contents or adulteration or either R/CR.A/1336/2012 JUDGMENT presence of any material, which may be harmful to the human being or there is no proof regarding absence of any required ingredients or presence of any unwanted ingredients. Thereby as per the report by the Public Analyst when the product is as per the standard laid down in the Act. However, in addition to merits, learned advocate Mr. Soni has pointed out one another glaring fact that though impugned judgment and order is dated 27.02.2012 and though the appeal is filed only on 22.08.2012, the appellant has failed to disclose the filing of appeal by the respondent before the Sessions Court, R/CR.A/1336/2012 JUDGMENT Rajpipla against the same impugned judgment under Section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure being Criminal Appeal No. 3 of 2012 whereby Sessions Court has though confirmed the conviction, extended the benefit of Probation of Offenders' Act to the respondent after following due procedure of law in the form of calling the report of Probation Officer, as requested by the respondent by an application at exhibit 13 of such appeal. Therefore, it is contended by learned advocate for the respondent that though State has appeared in such appeal before the Sessions Court through public prosecutor and though report of Probation Officer was produced before the Sessions Court and though Sessions Court has decided the appeal on 26.06.212, while preferring this appeal on 22.08.2012 i.e. two months after the judgment by the Sessions Court, appellant herein has suppressed such facts and appeal was filed with an application to condone the delay which was allowed in absence of such information. Learned advocate Mr.Soni has shown the certified copy of such judgment dated 26.06.2012 by the Sessions Court, Rajpipla in Criminal Appeal No. 3 of 2012, which is certainly against impugned order dated 22.02.2012 in Criminal Case No. 543 of 2010 by the JMFC, Sagbara.
